title: Scutter! he cried thickly.
html_source:
When you scutter, you are scurrying and bustling about.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: “Scutter” is Dublin slang for shit of the consistency that can pebble-dash the toilet bowl, (normally after drinking about ten pints of Guinness). He is not referring to “scurrying and bustling about.”
